The AI writing partner for work

Built to help you write better

Grammarly is built on a simple belief: anyone can communicate effectively and persuasively with the right tools. Clear communication fuels results that speak for themselves, whether in a winning sales pitch, an essay that makes the grade, or a message that strikes exactly the right tone.

Our linguists and researchers work at the frontier of natural language processing and generative AI, with one goal in mind: to help people write with more clarity, more confidence, and a voice that's entirely their own.

Everything you need, wherever you write

Grammarly works across more than 1 million apps and websites, so help is always there when you need it. AI writing agents refine your tone, suggest rewrites, and help make your arguments land. And when you want a focused space to write from scratch, docs gives you a distraction-free home with all the assistance built right in.

Grammarly Free helps anyone write with confidence. Grammarly Pro helps professionals and teams make every message more effective. Grammarly for Education gives students and institutions campus-wide access to writing support that builds real communication skills, both inside and beyond the classroom.

Grammarly is now a part of the Superhuman Suite.

Our journey so far

In 2009, Max Lytvyn, Alex Shevchenko, and Dmytro Lider founded Grammarly with a simple goal: help people communicate more effectively. What began as a grammar checker for students grew into something much bigger: a trusted AI partner helping millions express their ideas with clarity and confidence.

Over time, Grammarly evolved from a writing assistant into an AI-powered communication platform that works everywhere people write. It has become so seamless that most users don’t even think of it as AI. It is just part of how work gets done.

In 2025, we acquired Coda and Superhuman Mail, marking the start of Grammarly’s next evolution.

In October, our company became Superhuman. The new name unites all three products under one brand and one mission. Grammarly remains at the core, continuing to help millions find the right words. Superhuman represents what comes next: an AI-native productivity platform built to unlock the best in everyone.

We're building on 16 years of learning: that AI works best when it feels effortless, and that technology should make people more capable, not replace them. That belief started everything. And now, with Superhuman, that power is everywhere you work.
